key_insight: DMuon makes matrix-aware Muon optimization practical at scale by cutting its optimizer overhead to near-AdamW levels while preserving the benefits of orthogonalized updates.
engineering_relevance: It plugs into existing distributed training pipelines as a drop-in module, improving training efficiency for large foundation models and LLMs without requiring framework changes.
method: Distributed Muon implementation for existing training stacks
Designed to reduce optimizer-step bottlenecks in large-scale training
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 1.48x-3.01x end-to-end step-time speedup and 6.85x-163.00x optimizer-step speedup across embodied foundation model and LLM training workloads.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on matrix shape, workload, and distributed system details, so integration and benchmarking are important before production use.
paper_title: DMuon: Efficient Distributed Muon Training with Near-Adam Overhead
